privacy_intro: At Sun Over The Cloud, we value your privacy and believe in minimal, transparent data retention. This policy outlines how your information is handled when using our weather application.
privacy_data_collected_desc: When you register an account, we collect your username, email address, and a securely salted password (hashed with Argon2). Geolocation coordinates are used strictly client-side to request local weather and can be saved locally for 30 days with your permission. Saved favorites are synchronized to your account in our secure database.
privacy_cookies_desc: We use a secure, HTTP-only cookie (SESSION_TOKEN) to keep you signed in for 30 days with sliding renewal on active visits. Your browser's localStorage and IndexedDB store theme preferences, language settings, and cached forecast snapshots to provide an instantaneous offline-capable experience.
privacy_third_party_desc: Weather forecasts are retrieved from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute (MET Norway) based solely on latitude and longitude coordinates. Monthly historical climate graphs are provided by Open-Meteo. Reverse geocoding for city names uses BigDataCloud. Optional Google authentication delegates login directly to Google without exposing your password.
privacy_rights_desc: You retain full control over your data. You may review, modify, or permanently delete your account and all associated favorite locations at any moment from your Account settings. Account deletion immediately cascades and permanently purges all your records from our systems.
privacy_contact_desc: If you have any questions regarding your personal data or this policy, you can reach out via the personal website and portfolio links available in the footer.
terms_intro: Welcome to Sun Over The Cloud. By accessing or using our application, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions.
terms_use_desc: Sun Over The Cloud is provided for personal, non-commercial informational purposes. You agree not to perform automated mass-scraping, denial-of-service attempts, or actions that burden upstream weather API infrastructure.
terms_disclaimer_desc: Meteorological data and forecasts are aggregated from public scientific models (MET Norway, Open-Meteo) and provided 'as is'. While we strive for accuracy, weather predictions inherently carry uncertainty. Do not rely on this application for life-critical safety, marine navigation, or emergency decision-making.
terms_account_desc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. We reserve the right to suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms or engage in abusive activity.
terms_liability_desc: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Sun Over The Cloud and its creators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.
